changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/6499-inactive-values-retained.md`

- names `flow-node-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > - New `inactiveRetainedKind(field, node, fields)` in `flow-node-config.ts` — a pure read that reports a field rendered ONLY because the stored-value re-show rule fired. It distinguishes `'controller-off'` (a real toggle the author can switch back on) from `'no-controller'` (the `__legacy__` render-only keys, where no such toggle exists and saying otherwise would be a fresh lie). - `FlowNodeConfigField` renders the notice beside the affected control, with a "Clear value" action so the author can discard the residue **deliberately**. Read-only inspectors show the notice without the action. - Coverage is every `showWhen` group in the inspectors, pinned mechanically: all 33 gated fields across the descriptor tables, plus the two runtime producers (an engine-published `configSchema` and a connector input schema) that mint groups no source file contains.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

### `.changeset/9278-end-outcome-select.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` declared the `end` group's `outcome` key as a free-text box with `placeholder: 'success · failure'`. `EndConfigSchema.outcome` is a closed enum of `completed | refused` defaulting to `completed`, and `FlowNodeSchema` discriminates an `end` node's config through it — so both printed words are refused at parse, not ignored at run time. Measured against the installed `@objectstack/spec` (17.4.0), with the accepted row in the same output so the refusals are a reading rather than a dead probe:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `3e71a9825` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1745 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2349 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36564819781)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4de4b51ea4a4b3e5f16ceb3855d3719dde8d244f`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11067 (body and its 3 comments: triage `5887202725`, claim `5888477811`, os-dev-report `5889800745`); PR #11090 (body, 5-file list, net diff against `main`, +299/-4); the head's check-runs read with `filter=latest` (42 runs at the first read, 43 once the `Test` rollup appeared). Context reads by the contents API at the head: `flow-node-config.ts`, `i18n.ts`, `inspectors/_shared.tsx`, `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`, app-shell `index.ts` and `package.json`; 47 flow/trigger/locale sources under `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` grepped for the token and the wording; the six other open PRs' file lists and a compare against `main` of the recent PR-less `claude/issue-*` branches. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Binding direction, triage `5887202725`: remove the option, don't invent the route; a stored `triggerType: 'event'` loads as the select's flagged unknown value and is never silently rewritten; pins: the option is absent, a stored `event` start node shows the flag and saves unchanged.

1. **The option leaves the select — right.** `flow-node-config.ts` drops `{ value: 'event', label: 'Platform event' }` from the `start` inspector's `triggerType` options (:412 at the head is now the comment saying why, beside the objectui#11054 `api` note). No other offered option or option label among the 47 candidate sources carries the token or the wording. The only other `平台事件` at the head is `FLOW_META_ZH.type.event` (`i18n.ts` :6245), the flow-level `type` header pill's display fallback through `translateFlowMeta`, which offers nothing to pick (see ③).
2. **Both `showWhen` gates drop `'event'` — right, and that is the whole of the card's named site** (the select and the `objectName` / `condition` lists, now :437 and :448). No third list names the token at the head: the file's remaining `event` hits are the `waitEventConfig` / `boundary_event` field paths and the help text "every event".
3. **A stored `event` loads as the flagged unknown value and is never rewritten — right, by construction rather than by new code.** `InspectorSelectField` (`_shared.tsx` :445-:530, objectui#8488 / #9651) synthesises a selectable first row for a non-empty value the roster does not offer; a literal `options` array makes `rosterVerdict` answer `answered` (:274), so the row draws `unknownValueLabel(current)`, which the flow select branch (`FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` :384-:391) words as `flagUnknownValue(v, t('engine.form.deprecated'))`. Nothing on that path commits: `onValueChange` fires only on an author pick. The diff adds no write, no migration and no default, and the dev built no new UI or string, which is the right reading of the claim's "measure first, build only if missing". The accept set for the stored value does not move: `event` stays a value a node may carry; only the offer set narrows.
4. **Gated fields on a stored-`event` node — right.** `objectName` / `condition` no longer show on the token alone; a stored `objectName` beside it stays visible through the stored-value re-show rule (`isFieldVisible` :1355, objectui#6499 Option C) and reads `inactiveRetainedKind` as `controller-off` (:1467), so retained config is neither hidden nor pruned. Pinned by the table half's last two cases with a live `record-after-create` control.
5. **Public surface: nothing moves.** `flow-node-config.ts` and the inspector are not re-exported by `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (no `export *`, no `inspectors/` path), and `package.json` exports only `.` and `./styles.css`. The narrowing is the Studio select's offer set, a UI behaviour, not a published type, export or accept set.
6. **Pins match the direction.** `flow-node-config.platformEvent-11067.test.ts`: the resolver answers no kind for `event` with an `api` control; no option writes `event`; no gate names it; every gated value is offered; the zh overlay labels only offered options; a stored `event` hides the two fields on the token alone and keeps a stored `objectName` flagged retained. `FlowNodeInspector.platformEvent-11067.test.tsx`: no such row with a `Webhook / API` control; en-US and zh-CN draw the flagged value with a not-bare control; the flagged row is selectable; two round-trips save `{ triggerType: 'event' }` and `{ triggerType: 'event', objectName: 'task' }` back unchanged. Ablations A1-A3 in the PR body match their predictions; the round-trip cases are unablated by design and the dev says so.
7. **Check-runs on the head (`filter=latest`): 43 runs, all completed, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure.** The 8 test shards, the `Test` rollup, Test (dist pins), Type Check, Lint, Spec Main Shape Gate, Build & E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, the four Changeset runs, Inert vi.mock Specifier Check, Line Citation Gate, Control Byte Scan, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the doc, skill and import-graph checks are all `success`. The 3 skipped are Test (coverage), its shard matrix and dependabot, skipped by workflow condition, not by a failure. The test shards and Spec Main Shape Gate were still in progress when this review started (12:02Z) and were waited on in the foreground until the last completed at 12:09:50Z; no run was re-run.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11067-drop-platform-event-trigger.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` — **right.** The diff publishes a fix in one released package: a Studio select stops offering a value no engine routes, and a stored value is kept as written. No type, export, schema or accept set changes (①.5). Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read and Changeset Fixed Group Check are green on the head. The changeset body says what an author sees and what to do (pick an offered trigger).

Clause-②: no — matches the claim `5888477811` and the PR body. Nothing here moves an objectstack contract, a spec accept set or a public export, and the direction forbids an `event` trigger kind.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags: `deviations` 4, `open_questions` 0, `out_of_scope_findings` 2 (os-dev-report `5889800745`).

- **D1, surface deviation: one line removed from `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`FLOW_FIELD_ZH` `start.triggerType.opts.event: '平台事件'`), a file the claim does not name — answered, accepted.** (a) It is the same option's zh half, inside the direction: `localizeField` (`flow-node-config.ts` :1278-:1280) applies the overlay only by mapping `field.options` and reading `z.opts[o.value]`, so an overlay key is read exactly when the select offers that value; "the option leaves the select" takes its zh label with it. (b) Leaving it would have left a dead overlay row: with the option gone nothing reads `opts.event`, and the pin "the zh overlay labels only options the select offers" (ablation A3, 1 red / 12 green as predicted, mutant blob `98a9c7936` equal to the base blob) would have failed or been written around. Same shape as PR objectui#11064's `webhook` to `api` overlay swap. The seat may amend the claim's file surface to name `i18n.ts`.
  Landing-order note for the seat: no open PR touches `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (file lists of #11091, #11089, #11086, #11069, #10278 and #5400 read). Of the PR-less in-flight branches compared against `main`, `claude/issue-11027-preview-display-keys` (`335a6c38`, ahead 3, no PR yet) adds one `engine.appPreview.areas` row to `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` at :1465 and to `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` at :4352, about 1,500 lines above the `FLOW_FIELD_ZH` `start.triggerType` overlay at :5886-:5902 this PR edits: no textual overlap, either landing order merges clean. The stale `claude/issue-10835-dashboard-preview-debug-run-locale` (behind 146) adds `ENGINE_STRINGS` rows at :418 / :1218 / :2807 / :3619, also disjoint. `claude/issue-10993-batch2-i18nlabel-reads` does not touch the file.
- **D2, the full inspectors-directory vitest run was at `c5ebc3d93`, not the head — answered.** The head differs by one test-only `readOnly={false}` line; the head's CI test shards 1-8 are the run of record (①.7), and the type-check and the four flow pin files were re-run at the head.
- **D3, verify-lock queue timeouts and a lowered wait — process only.** No bearing on the contract; nothing to escalate.
- **D4, commit trailers follow objectui AGENTS.md's model-free pair — process only.** The role file's precedence is the dev's to follow; not a contract gate here.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`, both carrier none, noted not filed:** (i) `FLOW_META_ZH.type` keeps `event`, `webhook`, `manual` and `time_relative` display labels for the flow-level `type` header pill (`i18n.ts` :6235-:6260, verified at the head): a fallback for a stored value, not an offered option, outside this card; (ii) objectstack's `validate-flow-trigger-readiness` reports an off-grammar `triggerType` only on `record_change` flows, a read not a measurement, and the census finds no producer of the token after this PR. Neither blocks; both are the seat's to file or drop.
